name: Shenzhen Injoinic Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: Shenzhen Injoinic Technology Co.,Ltd. engages in the research, development, and sale of power management chips and fast charging protocol chips, battery management chips, and mixed-signal SoCs in China and internationally. The company offers power bank fully integrated chip, wireless charging soc chip, car charger chip, charging protocol chip, lithium battery charging chip, PMU, boost chip and OVP, lithium battery protection chip, single-cell dual-in-one lithium battery protection chip, TWS charging case chip, e-cigarettes, AC-DC flyback controller, and AC/DC synchronous rectification power management chip products.
